propositions: _lib_writes.py is at the 800-line hard cap and blocks all new write verb changes, preventing a sibling story from adding optional create_ticket arguments

The module combines seven concerns (genesis, identity/key material, status lifecycle, leaf mutations, session logs, store maintenance, signing) that should be split by concern rather than by dependency
The solution splits _lib_writes into three modules: _lib_mutations.py (concerns 4+5+6), _lib_identity.py (concerns 2+7), and _lib_writes.py (concerns 1+3), all within 100-500 LOC band
All 27 public names and _python_leaf remain re-exported from _lib_writes with noqa: F401 to preserve API surface, leaving __init__.py and _lib_gates.py unchanged
The three modules must import cleanly in any order without cycles, and all existing tests pass without modification
